IN THE HIGH COURT OF JHARKHAND AT RANCHI  B.A. No. 11394 of 2025  -------
Sajjad Ansari, aged about 25 years, son of Kayum Ansari, resident of village Hanhat, P.O. & P.S.
Kuru, District Lohardaga.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JHARKHAND AT RANCHI
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ...... .... Petitioner(s) Versus The State of Jharkhand ..... .... Opp. Party --------

CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH --------
For the Petitioner(s) : Mr. Nilesh Kumar, Advocate
Mr. Altamash Khan, Advocate For the State : Mr. Praful Jojo, A.P.P

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Lohardaga (M) P.S. Case No. 34 of 2024,
corresponding to Spl. POCSO Case No.11 of 2025, for the offence under Sections 376(2)(n), 417 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 06 of POCSO Act, subsequently, charges have been framed under Sections 376(2)(n) & 417 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of POCSO Act, pending in the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I-cum-Special Judge, Lohardaga.
Bail application of the petitioner was earlier rejected by this Court vide B.A. No. 7932/2025, by order dated 02.09.2025.
Attention has been drawn towards the deposition of the victim recorded during the trial, in which,
she has stated that their physical relationship was consensual.
